We further considered four tasks for both the foreground (attended) and background (ignored) speaker or speech, covering different levels of speech and language processing: Speaker Description (acoustic) evaluates the accuracy of identifying the gender (G), pitch (P), and tempo (T) of the target speaker. Speech Transcription (phonetic & syntactic) measures transcription quality using word error rate (WER) and BLEU against the target speaker's actual speech. Speech Summarization (semantic) assesses summary quality with ROUGE-L and METEOR, using three GPT-4o mini (OpenAI, 2024) reference summaries. The highest-scoring reference is reported. Free Q&A (semantic & pragmatic) evaluates responses to questions about the target speech, such as sentiment analysis, fact-checking, and named entity recognition. Three questions and reference answers were generated by GPT-4o mini, with performance measured by ROUGE-L and METEOR.
A total of 40 participants were recruited through Prolific to evaluate model-generated answers.
